products.description:
Get Gmail mail flow, routing, and email authentication right

Mail that silently lands in spam, spoofed domains, and compliance gaps trace back to mail flow, routing, and authentication that were never designed. This solution configures Gmail's enterprise mail plane end to end: inbound/outbound routing and hosts, split/dual delivery for coexistence, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC (monitor → enforce), content-compliance and routing rules, and attachment/spam controls — so mail is deliverable, authenticated, and compliant.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (Admin SDK / APIs).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Gmail mail plane: routing/hosts, split & dual delivery, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, content-compliance/routing rules, and the enforcement journey.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + super-admin, DNS control for the domains, coexistence source if any, compliance policy).
  • Implementation Guide — configure routing/hosts, set up SPF/DKIM and DMARC (p=none → quarantine → reject with report review), build content-compliance + routing rules, and tune spam/attachment controls — pilot-first, each rule named.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (auth passing, DMARC aligned, rules routing correctly) plus Best Practices for safely moving DMARC to enforcement without breaking legitimate senders.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Gmail mail flow designed, not accidental — routing correct, SPF/DKIM/DMARC enforced with reporting, compliance rules in place — deliverable, authenticated, and audit-ready email.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • dmarc_policy_planner.py — Plan the next safe DMARC record (monitor->quarantine->reject) as a dry-run
    • dmarc_rua_analyzer.py — Parse DMARC aggregate (RUA) reports and summarize sender alignment (read-only)
    • mailauth_validate.py — Validate SPF / DKIM / DMARC records for a domain and produce a pass/fail report
    • mailplane_config_export.py — Export & validate Gmail routing/domain config via the Admin SDK (read-only)
    • mailplane_dns_audit.py — Audit MX / SPF / DKIM / DMARC DNS posture for a set of domains (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
